investigation: Grant Cameron / Cooper-Cohen Edwards film lead

evidence.title: Gordon Cooper Talks UFOs With Defense Secretary
evidence.claim: Cameron relays Steven Greer's account that Gordon Cooper approached Secretary of Defense William Cohen about a specific UFO landing film and that an effort was made to retrieve it.
evidence.tier: documented researcher report; hearsay as to Cooper-Cohen interaction

evidence.request: All correspondence or records of meetings between Secretary of Defense William Cohen and Astronaut Gordon Cooper.
All files related to UFOs, the 1947 crash in Roswell, New Mexico, or flying saucers from the files of Secretary of Defense William Cohen.
evidence.result: Approximately 21 pages; responsive materials in NSC Cables; no relevant WHORM or White House staff-office records.
evidence.tier: official Clinton Presidential Library finding aid

evidence.claim: Cooper spoke with the President and raised the matter with Secretary Cohen; Cohen's office called Mellon and tasked him to pursue the records.
evidence.followup: Mellon says an Air Force colonel told him records had been cleaned up or discarded to save space.
evidence.tier: first-person testimony from the official who says he received the tasking

evidence.claim: A request came to Mellon, which he thought was from President Clinton, about an astronaut's Edwards UFO videotape claim and desire for the President to retrieve it.
evidence.tier: first-person testimony; some uncertainty in routing/origin of request

currentAssessment.earlyCameronLead: partially corroborated by later Mellon first-person testimony
currentAssessment.interpretationBoundary: Government search activity does not establish the truth of Cooper's landing description or extraterrestrial origin.
